account.title: Account
account.description: Your account, theme, language and sign out.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.intro: What happened in the server lately, and whether the bot is running.
Overview.noCases: No cases yet. They appear here when someone is warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

BotStatus.title: Bot status
BotStatus.offlineHint: The dashboard can't reach the bot. It may be restarting.

Moderation.title: Cases
Moderation.intro: Every warning, timeout, kick and ban, whether it came from a command, this dashboard or Discord itself.

search.label: Search cases
search.placeholder: Name, user ID, reason or case number

empty.title: No cases yet
empty.body: Cases appear here when someone is warned, timed out, kicked or banned.

noMatch.title: No cases match
noMatch.body: Try another search or clear the filters.

detail.title: Case #{number}
detail.moreNone: No other cases for this member.
detail.searchMember: Search all cases for this member

pardon.title: Pardon this warning?
pardon.body: It stays in the history, marked as pardoned, and the log message in Discord is updated.
pardon.doneNoLog: Warning pardoned. The log message in Discord couldn't be updated.

errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
errors.notActiveWarning: That isn't an active warning any more.
errors.failed: Couldn't pardon the warning. Try again.

settings.title: Moderation settings
settings.intro: Where cases are posted in Discord and whether members are told.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.logChannelHelp: Every case is posted here as an embed. Cases are recorded either way.
settings.botOffline: The bot is offline, so the channel list isn't available. Your current channel is kept until you can pick a new one.
settings.dm: Message members when they're warned, timed out, kicked or banned
settings.dmHelp: If a member has direct messages closed, the action still goes through.
settings.savedBotLater: Settings saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks them up within a minute.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change these settings.
errors.botUnavailable: Can't reach the bot to check that channel. Try again in a moment.
errors.channelNotFound: That channel doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
errors.failed: Couldn't save the settings. Try again.

TempVoice.title: Voice rooms
TempVoice.intro: Members who join a lobby get a room of their own. See the rooms that are open now, manage your lobbies and change the rules every room follows.

monitor.title: Open rooms
monitor.summary: {rooms, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} with {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in them

empty.title: No rooms open
empty.body: A room appears when someone joins a lobby and disappears when it is empty.

off.title: Temporary rooms are switched off
off.body: Joining a lobby does nothing right now. Turn them on under General settings below.

monitor.offline: The dashboard can't reach the bot, so the live view isn't available.
monitor.noPeople: Nobody is in the room right now
monitor.missingBody: It can't create rooms from these lobbies until its role has the permissions listed, on the lobby's category.

lobbies.title: Lobbies
lobbies.intro: Each lobby is a voice channel members join to get a room. Every lobby has its own category, name, member limit and defaults.
lobbies.botOffline: The bot is offline, so the channel lists aren't available. You can still see and remove your lobbies.

empty.title: No lobbies yet
empty.body: Add a voice channel as a lobby. Members who join it get their own room.

dialog.channelHelp: The voice channel members join. Pick one that isn't a lobby yet.
dialog.channelFixed: The channel can't be changed. To use another channel, remove this lobby and add a new one.
dialog.noChannelsLeft: Every voice channel the bot can see is already a lobby.
dialog.categoryHelp: Rooms from this lobby are created here. Leave it empty to put them next to the lobby.
dialog.limitHelp: 0 means no limit. Owners can change it for their own room.
dialog.video: Allow video and screen sharing in its rooms
dialog.soundboard: Allow the soundboard in its rooms
dialog.defaultsHelp: Owners can switch these for their own room.
dialog.enabledHelp: Switch it off to pause only this lobby.

lobbies.savedBotLater: Lobby saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks it up within a minute.
lobbies.removeBody: Members can't create rooms from it any more. Rooms that are open now stay until they are empty.

general.title: General settings
general.enabledHelp: The master switch. When off, joining any lobby does nothing. Open rooms are still deleted once they are empty.
general.defaultBlocklistHelp: A built-in list of {count} patterns, English and German. It also catches disguised spellings like sh1t or f*ck, but leaves innocent words such as "class" alone. It applies to new rooms and to renames.
general.blockedHelp: Room names containing one of these are refused, on top of the built-in list. One per line or separated by commas. They are plain words, not patterns. Capital letters and invisible characters don't get around them.
general.savedBotLater: Settings saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks them up within a minute.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change these settings.
errors.invalid: Some of these values aren't valid.
errors.templateBlocked: The room name contains a blocked word. Change it, or every new room would be called "Voice room".
errors.needsLobby: Add a lobby before switching temporary rooms on.
errors.botUnavailable: Can't reach the bot to check those channels. Try again in a moment.
errors.lobbyNotFound: That isn't a voice channel the bot can see.
errors.categoryNotFound: That category doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
errors.alreadyALobby: That channel is already a lobby, or it is one of the temporary rooms.
errors.tooManyLobbies: There can be at most {max} lobbies. Remove one first.
errors.notFound: That lobby doesn't exist any more. Reload the page.

Errors.loadFailedBody: Something went wrong while loading it. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, the dashboard's log has the details.

Twitch.title: Twitch
Twitch.intro: Announce in Discord when a channel goes live. The bot listens to Twitch itself; you connect an account once and pick the channels to announce.
Twitch.savedBotLater: Saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks this up within a minute.

outcome.cancelled: The Twitch login was cancelled. Nothing changed.
outcome.invalidState: That login link expired or didn't match. Start again with the connect button.
outcome.noRefreshToken: Twitch didn't give a long-lived login. Try connecting again.
outcome.notConfigured: Twitch isn't set up on the server yet (client ID, secret and encryption key).
outcome.failed: Couldn't finish the Twitch login. Try again.

connection.title: Connection
connection.none: No Twitch account is connected. Twitch only lets bots listen for stream events with a login, so pick any account (your own is fine). It asks for no permissions.
connection.notConfigured: Twitch isn't set up on the server yet: the client ID, client secret and encryption key are missing.
connection.explain: This login has no permissions beyond identifying the account. It is stored encrypted and only used to let the bot listen for streams going live and ending.

settings.title: Announcements
settings.enabledHelp: Needs a connected account and at least one channel below.
settings.markEnded: Edit the message when the stream ends
settings.markEndedHelp: The announcement turns grey and says when the stream ended.

streamers.title: Channels
streamers.intro: Each channel posts into its own Discord channel, optionally pinging a role.

empty.title: No channels yet
empty.body: Use Add channel to announce the first one.

streamers.needsConnection: Connect a Twitch account above before adding channels.
streamers.limitReached: That is the most one Twitch connection can follow ({max}). Remove a channel to add another.

confirm.disconnectBody: Announcements stop until an account is connected again. Past announcements stay in Discord.
confirm.removeBody: {name} will no longer be announced. Past announcements stay in Discord.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change these settings.
errors.notFound: That channel doesn't exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.invalidLogin: That isn't a valid Twitch channel name (3 to 25 letters, numbers or underscores).
errors.botUnavailable: Can't reach the bot to check that. Try again in a moment.
errors.twitchNotFound: Twitch has no channel with that name.
errors.channelNotFound: That Discord channel doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
errors.roleNotFound: That role doesn't exist any more.
errors.tooManyStreamers: That is the most channels one Twitch connection can follow. Remove one first.
errors.alreadyAdded: That channel is already on the list.

form.loginHelp: The name in the channel's address, for example twitch.tv/NAME.
form.loginFixed: The Twitch channel can't be changed. Remove it and add another to switch.
form.channelHelp: Several people can share one Discord channel.
form.botOffline: The bot is offline, so the channel list isn't available. The current channel is kept.
form.roleHelp: This role is mentioned above the announcement. Nothing else can ping anyone.
form.savedBotLater: Saved. The bot wasn't reachable, so it picks this up within a minute.
